The interviewer has asked the following question:
             Why does C++ use pointers even if Java and other high-level programming languages don't use them? Why do we use them?

Because C++ is a low-level programming language wherein it doesn't care so much about security while Java and other high-level programming languages care about security. We also use pointers in C++ so that we can pass by reference instead of passing by value in functions.
